Post-CAS outcome/recovery truthful; no expired/unverified source adoption. Original short source/effect snapshot is never extended.
durable_adoption.post_setup: Explicit committed signed adoption converts source preference to durable selected configuration until current policy replacement/revocation, not a renewed setup effect. setup_deadline_unix remains historical admission boundary, not runtime grant TTL. Runtime preference resolution requires actual current row signature/hash/epoch/source/key/policy generation and active adoption, not live RootBootstrapSession.
durable_adoption.rules: consent_id nullable only non-consent purpose. Current source row held from protected journal, original signature verified with genuine selected key/current root key custody; exact source payload/current source members and active projection profile/namespace/owner/policy. Current row revoked/missing or epoch/hash mismatch denies even same active pointer. PublishedSetupChoiceAdoption.verify_current delegates this actual resolver; no descriptor-only result.
durable_adoption.revocation: Authorized current owner/root request causes signed durable epoch/revocation transition in root journal using existing actual authority key finite choice-revocation domain; atomic fsync/current index. Revocation survives restart and invalidates all derived active choice/current receipts. No raw caller epoch, parallel key, arbitrary signing. Owned cleanup remains separate retained PIDFD obligation.
durable_adoption.runtime_grants: Every effect/input/start/capture projection is fresh nonrenewing <=30s bound current source/consent/policy/runtime; preference has no effect authority. Old receipt expiry remains immutable. Runtime registry uses actual AuthorityService domain verify/sign bridge, never imports private signer or reconstructs new service.

public_identity.consent_id: Root public choice producer mints a distinct opaque stable consent_id via CSPRNG>=128bits when actual rootTTY public normal configuration is recorded; stores it in signed closed public choice payload and active choice adoption projection. Different from choice_handle/selection_handle/choice_observation_id; caller cannot choose/alias IDs. Reconfiguration/revocation creates genuine signed transition/new consent identity where policy changes.
public_identity.recipient: Source-defined logical recipient for this finite public-free HTTPS read family is exactly public-web. Add literal to public choice/scope source policy, not infer tests/profile. It is a capability route label, not URL/ownership proof; selected target/scopes/current operation and source ceiling still independently verified. No other public provider/memory/paid scope granted. v142 scope recipient must equal this literal for this family.

runtime_disclosure.source: Actual installed root controller actor/current release/source closure/PIDFD, separately selected native input peer; never relabel root controller as worker. No RootBootstrapSession/_check_live dependency and no setup lease extension.
runtime_disclosure.tty: Reuse genuine root_setup._capture_root_tty_proof/_verify_root_tty_proof through source-owned RootRuntimeForegroundTTYObserver adapter. runtime_disclosure.checks: Fresh actual current installed root actor + active selected/adopted public source configuration and distinctconsentID/currentepoch. Actual rootTTY disclosure same original pending input bytesSHA/size/selectedexecution/currentnativepeer/profile/namespace owner, selectedpublicscopes/zero budget. Raw profile/publiclabel/persisted choice cannot classify input. PRIVATE/UNKNOWN ancestry/history/memory/credentials deny; emptyparents only actual new disclosed source v149.
runtime_disclosure.lease: Perinput disclosure/permission <=30s and <=originalTTY/input/selectedexecution/source limits. Deadline never renews; after expiration new actual observation required. Runtime adoption preference may survive setup closure but not create input/effect grant. Every dispatch/retry current epoch/source/scope/recipient intersection rechecked.
